description: User selects two commits. Client initiates SSE stream. Server extracts graph snapshots at each commit via detached-HEAD worktrees (cached in SQLite). Server computes ArchDiff using semantic IDs. Client receives the diff, builds a merged view with added/removed/modified status colouring, and re-runs the view pipeline on the merged data.
label: Temporal Diff to Overlay

members.note: Client entry. Opens SSE stream for progress. Requests snapshots and diff.
Creates worktree, initialises CodeGraph, extracts snapshot, caches, cleans up.
Maps nodes by semantic ID. Detects the six operation types. Sorts deterministically.
Re-runs computeView on cached diff data. Called when filters change.
Applies current filters to the merged diff graph.
